title: Inkling 2 Small Explained - 594B MoE on Tinker
content:
Thinking Machines Lab ne roughly 5 Nov
2026 ko Inkling 2 Small release kiya.
Mira Murati ki lab. Sparse
Mixture-of-Experts: 594 BILLION total
parameters, 17 BILLION ACTIVE.
Text plus image. Variable reasoning
effort. Up to 1 MILLION TOKEN context.
AA Intelligence Index 31 — predecessor
Inkling Small pe 13 tha.
End pe Comment keyword TINKER dunga — docs
link DM mil jayega.

Verified numbers MarkTechPost aur lab table se.
SWE-Bench Pro v2 Hard pe 86.3 PERCENT —
lab ke table mein strong coding score.
Architecture: 48-layer decoder-only. Har
token 8 of 384 experts pe route. Vision
encoder 292 million parameters.
Live on Tinker for fine-tuning aur
inference. Weights abhi closed. Apache 2.0
weights planned next week after external
safety testing.
Pricing Artificial Analysis ke through
cite: 0.30 dollars per 1 million input
tokens, 1.00 dollar per 1 million output
tokens — MarkTechPost 5 Nov snapshot.
SiliconAngle ne reported 5 billion
fundraising push / 40 billion valuation
mention kiya via Business Insider —
reported hai, confirmed fact mat treat
karo spoken mein as hard truth.

Pehle clear: yeh kya NAHI hai.
Yeh abhi free self-host weights nahi hai.
Self-hosting hardware disclosed nahi.
Weights Apache 2.0 next week planned —
safety testing ke baad.
Audio support abhi nahi — text aur image
input, text output.
Terminal-Bench 4.0 pe lab table mein 13.1
percent — weak spot. Har benchmark pe king
nahi.
Matlab: coding-heavy MoE try karo, lekin
harness aur eval apne domain pe chalao.

Practical how-to.
Step 1: Tinker Playground kholo.
Inkling-2-Small try karo — multimodal
prompt, variable effort.
Step 2: fine-tune path. Tinker Cookbook
use karo. model_name set karo
THINKINGMACHINES/INKLING-2-SMALL.
Step 3: wait for open weights before
self-host claims. Jab Apache 2.0 drop ho,
tabhi local deploy stories.
Maan lo tum ek internal coding agent
fine-tune kar rahe ho — pehle Playground
pe 10 real tickets, phir Cookbook
fine-tune, phir reject log rakho.
Hypothetical workflow hai.

Kab pick karo.
Agentic coding, vision plus knowledge
work, long context up to 1 million tokens.
Price class mein AA Index 31, ranked about
number 4 of 29 per MarkTechPost read.
Jab Terminal-style shell benches matter
karte hain, pehle apna harness measure
karo — lab ka 13.1 percent weak signal
hai.
Alignment pe lab ne misbehavior score 66.8
se 14.9 tak giraya internal metric pe —
interesting, lekin tumhara prod eval alag
hoga.

Mera take simple hai.
594B total / 17B active MoE with 1M
context on Tinker is a real
open-weight-path play — lekin path open
weights ke baad complete hota hai.
Aaj: Playground try, Cookbook fine-tune
name lock, self-host claims hold.
Numbers chase mat karo blindly. SWE-Bench
86.3 percent impressive hai; Terminal 13.1
percent humility hai.

Comment TINKER — main tumhe MarkTechPost
ya Thinking Machines Tinker docs link DM
kar dunga.
Follow karo, roz ka AI update yahin milega.
